title: Scaling and Polishing
description:
Scaling and Polishing is a professional dental cleaning procedure that helps maintain healthy teeth and gums. Scaling removes plaque, tartar, and bacteria buildup from the teeth and gum line, while polishing smoothens the tooth surface and removes stains for a cleaner, brighter smile.
This treatment helps prevent gum disease, bad breath, and tooth decay while improving overall oral hygiene. It is a quick, safe, and painless procedure recommended for maintaining long-term dental health and a fresh, confident smile.
